D53·nnqz — 2026-11-15
chose: 5.2 is a new crate, crates/sofar-ffi, that depends on uniffi 0.32 and sofar-core and builds as a cdylib and staticlib. It exposes `sofar serve`'s /state and /state/<slug> response bodies as JSON strings, folded by the Rust core. It ships as an xcframework wrapped in a Swift package.
over: (a) A hand-written C ABI using cbindgen plus a hand-written Swift wrapper. (b) Typed UniFFI records that mirror InitiativeState field by field.
because: desktop-v2's SofarKit already decodes serve's JSON into InitiativeState. A JSON-string FFI therefore makes the CoreFFI RecordSource a transport swap, and keeps the schema out of a second place. Typed records would copy the schema outside packages/schema/src, which breaks that guard-rail. UniFFI generates the Swift glue, the string handling and the error mapping, all of which (a) writes by hand. Being a separate crate, the hook binary's crates stay exactly the D9 set. The FFI crate defines its own lint table, because the workspace's `unsafe_code = forbid` cannot be allowed inside the extern-C scaffolding that UniFFI emits.
